messages:
Iris Novak: created a docs PR to update the Crescent8b model card — adding notes about multi-device sharding, embedding support, runtime flags, and a tiny SDK embedding snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/1512

Diego Ramos: skimmed the draft. we should be explicit about the sharded runtime requirement for >16k contexts. current text says 'supports sharding' but doesn't state when it's necessary. Can we add a 'when to shard' subsection?

Alex Wu: +1. from perf: single-GPU 80GB runs fine up to ~12k tokens for batch=1 (fp16). beyond that use sharded or dedicated multi-GPU. I'll paste quick numbers: 
```
Crescent8b fp16 (A100-80GB)
seq=12288 batch=1 p50=185ms p95=360ms memory headroom ok
seq=16384 batch=1 OOM on single 80GB, works on 2xA100-80GB sharded
quant q4_1 shows ~1.6x memory reduction but still needs sharding >14k
```
Add recommended_sharding_threshold: "16384"?

Diego Ramos: let's avoid a hard threshold in YAML. better: recommended_shard_for_sequences: ">=14k" and a note about driver/kernel variability.

Iris Novak: changed the YAML to `recommended_shard_sequences: ">=14000"` and added a short paragraph in the compatibility section about driver versions and multi-device PCIe/NVLink considerations.

Perf Eng: small addition — on q4_1 quant we saw the attention kernel fall back on cuda 11.6 drivers which increases latency ~20%. Recommendation: `cuda >= 12.1` for best perf; note older drivers may still run but expect slower kernels.

Alex Wu: also flag: the model supports embeddings but only with the non-streaming embedding endpoint (no streaming embed yet). include an example snippet and mention the output dimension (6144).

Iris Novak: proposed embedding snippet for SDK v3: 
```python
# SDK v3 embeddings example
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="${REDWOOD_KEY}")
resp = client.embeddings.create(model="crescent8b", input=["hello world"])
print(resp.data[0].embedding[:8])  # dims=6144
```
Keep it tiny and link to snippets/embed_v3.md

Sam Chen: tiny nit — in the docs frontmatter you added `supports_embedding: "true"` but our schema uses `supports_embeddings` (plural). please update so the catalog linter doesn't fail.

Iris Novak: fixed to `supports_embeddings: "true"`. thanks. Also added `embedding_dim: "6144"` and `embedding_recommendation: "use fp16 or q4_1 for lower mem; prefer batching for throughput"`.

Docs Bot: preview deployed: https://deploy-preview.redwood-docs/pr-1512 — linkcheck: one external link returned 503 intermittently (to third-party tokenizer repo). internal linter flagged `TODO` in the compatibility blurb.

Iris Novak: removed TODO and wrote the blurb: "Use sharded runtime for contexts >=14k tokens. Quantized profiles reduce memory but may change perf characteristics; test before rollout."

Perf Eng: added a CSV from the bench runs and a short reproducible command: `./run_bench --model crescent8b --mode fp16 --seq 12288 --bs 1 --dev a100-80` — attached in PR.

Diego Ramos: one more UX note — Console examples show streaming generate + stop tokens. since Crescent8b has long-context focus, add a short example showing `max_new_tokens` usage and a warning about token counting with prompt templates.

Iris Novak: added a one-line warning under the streaming examples and linked to /docs/guides/token-counting.

Sam Chen: lgtm, left a tiny wording suggestion on the compatibility paragraph.

Alex Wu: approved. :+1:

Diego Ramos: approved. :thumbsup:

Iris Novak: merging once CI is green. thanks y'all.
